name: Local Welfare Provision (incl. Crisis Resilience Fund)
whoFor: People in Kirklees in a short-term crisis who can't pay for food or energy.
eligibility: Gets Council Tax Reduction or is registered for council tax (or has a tenancy agreement)
Has no other way to meet the need

projects.name: Emergency crisis help
projects.overview: One-off help in a crisis: food parcels, prepaid meter vouchers and Crisis and Resilience Fund grants for food and energy. Help with rent is a separate Housing Payment.

provenance.source: Kirklees additional services spreadsheet v3 (October 2026), row 27
provenance.evidence: Council page: food and energy only; rent via Housing Payment. Phone hours 10-1 per the Welcome Centre.
provenance.status: Running (checked against the provider's site, 18 Nov 2026)
